head: b05f3e2cdbccdc6a04e8b800c00e26bf80f16110
governing_instruction: Do not add or retain compatibility shims, legacy aliases, migrations, old-shape handling, fallback paths, dual behavior or stale overrides; breaking changes are allowed.

findings.finding: A delayed failure from an older request can call unavailable() without its ordinal and overwrite a newer accepted READY projection.
findings.minimal_correction: Pass the failed ordinal to unavailable() and ignore failures older than the latest issued or accepted request.

findings.finding: Missing correlation fields default to empty/zero wildcards, while explicit mismatches can still expose verified game/process/window evidence to transition effects.
findings.minimal_correction: Require every current-schema correlation field, require exact local session/control correlation, and mask all evidence/effects on mismatch.

findings.finding: ConsoleActivity conditionally uses ProjectionOwner but retains the old Observations resolver and legacy SessionSnapshot constructors that synthesize READY.
findings.minimal_correction: Route all session decisions through one ProjectionOwner, incorporate orthogonal suspended/resume/sleep facts there, and delete the old resolver, waterfall and legacy constructors.

findings.finding: Provider, Gateway and Android retain active health/current/readiness routes and DTOs beside the canonical observation API; two Gateway control flows still consume the old reads.
findings.minimal_correction: Move remaining host consumers to one observation snapshot, then remove the old routes, aliases, facade, Android DTOs/methods and alias tests.

findings.finding: lastSafeGameId republishes a previous identity when no fresh evidence exists.
findings.minimal_correction: Remove the cache; game identity may come only from a fresh accepted observation or the exact matching retained owner.

notes: Review was read-only; production code, tests, services and devices were not changed or executed.
